opsContent.intro: Editorial state of Tracking Knowledge across the six locales, reader feedback per article, learning paths, sitemap and feed freshness and integration coverage. Read-only: the content lives in git, so changes are commits, not console actions.

common.readOnly: Read-only view of the content in git and of anonymous votes — no tenant data involved.

board.title: Editorial board
board.intro: One row per translation group with the status of every locale version from the front matter. A group is complete when every locale is published; a published version whose last review (reviewedAt, else the publication date) is older than {days} days counts as stale; a version without a takeaways list is flagged.
board.caption: Translation groups with their locale versions
board.emptyText: The loader found no article files under content/knowledge for the active locales.
board.emptyFilteredText: Widen the filters or reset them.

feedback.title: Reader feedback per article
feedback.intro: "Was this article helpful?" votes from the public articles: all-time and the last {days} days, split by locale. The votes are anonymous by design — there is nothing to drill into.
feedback.unavailableText: The knowledge_feedback table is missing on this database. Apply migration 0005 and reload.
feedback.emptyText: Votes appear here as soon as a reader answers the question under an article.
feedback.caption: Votes per article, most negative first
feedback.inboxLink: Open the 30-day digest in the inbox

paths.title: Learning paths
paths.intro: Curated paths from content/knowledge/paths.<locale>.json per locale: how many listed articles resolve to a published version and whether the hub shows the path. Ids that do not resolve are unknown groups or versions that are not published yet.
paths.caption: Learning paths per locale
paths.emptyText: No paths.<locale>.json file with valid entries exists under content/knowledge.
paths.hidden: Hidden on the hub (no article resolves)

freshness.title: Sitemaps and feeds
freshness.intro: The sitemap index, the knowledge sitemaps and the RSS feeds are rendered at build time from the published articles. The counts below are what the loader would render right now; when they differ from the live files, a new build is due.

build.title: Last build
build.noneText: There is no .next/BUILD_ID next to the app. In development the routes render on request, so the live files always match the loader.

freshness.caption: Sitemap and feed counts per locale

integrations.title: Integration coverage
integrations.intro: Which catalogue entries have published Tracking Knowledge articles per locale (an article's platforms or shop systems name the slug, or one of its tags is in the entry's knowledge tags — the same rule as the public integration page) and which have public vendor documentation on file. Entries with the fewest articles come first.
integrations.caption: Integrations with their knowledge coverage
integrations.openIntegrationLabel: Open the live integration page of {name}
